description: This is a Java source file defining an interface named AdministrationService, which contains method signatures for various administrative tasks related to system properties, global configurations, database operations, and system information in the OpenMRS medical record system.

classes.name: AdministrationService
classes.description: An interface for system-wide administrative operations, including management of global properties, system information, database access, implementation id, locale settings, validation, and serializer whitelists within the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: setAdministrationDAO
methods.description: Sets the DAO implementation to be used for database operations related to administration.

methods.name: getGlobalPropertyByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a global property identified by its UUID, ensuring only one such property exists.

methods.name: getSystemVariables
methods.description: Returns a sorted map of system variables used in OpenMRS.

methods.name: getSystemInformation
methods.description: Provides a map of various system information details such as Java version, user, and runtime properties.

methods.name: getGlobalProperty
methods.description: Fetches the value of a global property by its name, case-insensitive.

methods.name: getGlobalProperty
methods.description: Fetches the value of a global property by its name, returning a default if not found.

methods.name: getGlobalPropertyObject
methods.description: Retrieves the GlobalProperty object corresponding to a given property name.

methods.name: getGlobalPropertiesByPrefix
methods.description: Returns all global properties whose names start with the specified prefix.

methods.name: getGlobalPropertiesBySuffix
methods.description: Returns all global properties ending with the specified suffix.

methods.name: getAllGlobalProperties
methods.description: Fetches all global properties in the system.

methods.name: saveGlobalProperties
methods.description: Saves a list of global properties to the database, assigning UUIDs as needed.

methods.name: purgeGlobalProperty
methods.description: Removes a specific global property from the database.

methods.name: purgeGlobalProperties
methods.description: Removes multiple global properties from the database.

methods.name: setGlobalProperty
methods.description: Creates or updates a global property with the provided name and value.

methods.name: updateGlobalProperty
methods.description: Overwrites an existing global property with a new value; fails if the property does not exist.

methods.name: saveGlobalProperty
methods.description: Saves a global property object to the database, creating or overwriting as needed.

methods.name: addGlobalPropertyListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for global property changes.

methods.name: removeGlobalPropertyListener
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered global property listener.

methods.name: executeSQL
methods.description: Executes a raw SQL query on the database, optionally restricting to select statements.

methods.name: getImplementationId
methods.description: Returns the implementation ID configured for this server instance.

methods.name: setImplementationId
methods.description: Sets the implementation ID for the server, overwriting if it exists.

methods.name: getAllowedLocales
methods.description: Returns a list of locales permitted for use on the system.

methods.name: getPresentationLocales
methods.description: Provides the set of locales available for UI presentation, filtered by allowed locales.

methods.name: getGlobalPropertyValue
methods.description: Retrieves a global property value in its proper type, returning default if not found.

methods.name: getMaximumPropertyLength
methods.description: Returns the maximum allowed length for a specific property field.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation checks on an object to prevent premature flushes during manual validation modes.

methods.name: getSearchLocales
methods.description: Provides the list of locales used by the user during searches, considering user preferences and system settings.

methods.name: setImplementationIdHttpClient
methods.description: Configures the HTTP client used for accessing the OpenMRS implementation service.

methods.name: isDatabaseStringComparisonCaseSensitive
methods.description: Indicates whether the database performs case-sensitive string comparisons based on system configuration.

methods.name: updatePostgresSequence
methods.description: Adjusts sequence values for PostgreSQL after data insertions to maintain consistency.

methods.name: getSerializerWhitelistTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of package or class names whitelisted for safe deserialization, especially for XStream serializers.
